review.scope: Five empty-reference condo concepts visually compared with the style examples, including shared furnishings, room function and architecture.
review.style_signature: burgundy velvet sofa; round walnut coffee table; walnut media cabinet; walnut rectangular table and six olive upholstered chairs; ochre pleated pendants; jewel-tone patterned rug
review.limitations: Image concepts have minor differences in furniture scale, artwork and placement between cameras; not dimensionally verified model renders.
